mapper.sql: assignment_uuid, id, employee_uuid, assignment_type, event_date, company_name, utilization_rate, operator_user_id, remark, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `employee_assignment_record` (assignment_uuid, employee_uuid, assignment_type, event_date, company_name, utilization_rate, operator_user_id, remark, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{assignmentUuid}, #{employeeUuid}, #{assignmentType}, #{eventDate}, #{companyName}, #{utilizationRate}, #{operatorUserId}, #{remark}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM `employee_assignment_record` WHERE employee_uuid = #{employeeUuid} ORDER BY event_date ASC, id ASC
